features.title: Resident-Driven Proposals
features.description: Any resident can create petitions for building improvements, policy changes, or community initiatives.

features.title: Secure Digital Voting
features.description: Vote on proposals with confidence using our tamper-proof system that ensures one vote per verified resident.

features.title: Real-Time Results
features.description: Watch live vote counts and see proposal progress as your community weighs in on important decisions.

features.title: Transparent Communication
features.description: Direct messaging to building management with full visibility and accountability for every request.

steps.title: Register with Your Unit
steps.description: Sign up using your unique building registration code to verify you're a resident.

steps.title: Browse Active Proposals
steps.description: Review petitions created by fellow residents covering everything from amenities to policies.

steps.title: Cast Your Vote
steps.description: Support proposals you believe in with a single click—your vote is recorded securely and anonymously.

steps.title: Track the Outcome
steps.description: Follow petition progress, see results, and watch as your building management takes action on approved proposals.
